title: Sector 0's sinkhole is closed with a strike: Isao reminds after each construction wave cleared off the field, and once anything fills it no construction wave comes after it
context: Owner's third playtest (a996e005, 2026-09-30): "5) if a wave is finished, we need a reminder that the tremor point needs to be closed with a gunship strike." Nothing said so, and nothing made it worth doing: in sector 0 a construction wave re-opened a sinkhole a strike had filled (story-beats constructionWave), and in the sectors a breach closed early books LEFT IN THE FIELD while one held pays HELD. Asked which he meant, the owner chose "Sector 0 sinkhole, make it matter".
outcome: src/domain/story-beats.js construction: once the first construction wave has come up, a sinkhole found filled (the gunship's guns, the MK-9, the strike; anything that kills the source) is sealed for good: Isao says sinkhole_sealed and no construction wave comes after it; the Stålheart's print and the handover are unchanged. Until then, each time the field is cleared after a wave, Isao says sinkhole_strike (the first time: GUNSHIP on the strip, put a strike on it) or sinkhole_strike_again, once per wave. The hard cores still re-open a sinkhole filled before them (quiver phase), and the sectors' LEFT IN THE FIELD / HELD rule is untouched. state().story.construction carries sealed and reminded.
alternatives: A reminder without the rule: the owner chose to make it matter; a reminder to do something that changes nothing would teach the player to ignore Isao.
The reminder in the sectors too: their breaches already have the held-versus-closed trade and the brief card says it.
evidence: test/story-beats.mjs: no reminder while a wave is on the field; cleared -> sinkhole_strike once; the next wave cleared -> sinkhole_strike_again; sealed -> sinkhole_sealed once, no wave in 30 s after, not re-opened. The old assertion that a construction wave re-opens a filled sinkhole is replaced.

Browser --chapters chapters-stalheart: a real strike on the sinkhole (breachStrike) seals it, Isao says it, no construction wave in 13 s, the phase stays construction. --grow green; --pacing green with the same timeline (hull out 130.7 s, sector 1 card 284.1 s).
